1900.method: Inverse-distance interpolation within four independently bounded ground zones; preserve structures and drainage corridors; feather each zone to the earlier scaffold without blending across the intervening waterways or transport corridors.

zones.evidence: Low ground south of LT&SR and west of Manor Road; bounded independently from Mill Mead and the eastern marsh.
Ground east of Manor Road; retain ditch corridors and do not blend across the road/rail corridor.

1900.barrierHeights: Existing interpreted river, sewer and railway barriers retained; not validated flood defences.

protectionConflictReviews.sh_538598_183427: Source dot is at sewer embankment foot; rendered bank triangles and gasworks site overlap it. Use as adjacent-ground evidence, not a forced bank fit. Rendered bank section requires separate correction.
protectionConflictReviews.sh_538661_183378: Source dot is at embankment foot outside gasholder. Rendered sewer slope overlaps it; preserve crest/structures and retain adjacent-ground use pending bank-section refinement.
protectionConflictReviews.sh_538506_182847: Ground dot near interpreted Three Mills site boundary; transition rather than exact fit is acceptable at this stage. Do not flatten industrial pad.

1900.accuracyPolicy: Very good to excellent reconstruction using reviewed source readings and documented approximations. Prioritise consequential datum, barrier and connectivity uncertainties over exact fitting of every point.

sh_538960_182471.reason: Readers agree on height and position; disagree only marsh versus unmade path. Native map review shows no raised earthwork. Use as approximate local ground with 0.5m working ground uncertainty; preserve the original classification conflict.
